company.description: idea-L is an AI- and Web3-powered entrepreneurship platform designed to help people validate, fund, and launch business ideas. The company positions itself as an “AI co-founder in your pocket,” offering tools that guide users from idea generation to execution through a structured process called the Idea Realisation Platform (IRP™).
